meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声并部署到谷歌量子硬件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用谷歌量子硬件做低层电路开发或量子表征实验
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise, and deploy to Google quantum hardware
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing low-level quantum circuits for Google hardware or running characterization experiments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Python 编写、模拟和运行量子电路，支持参数扫描、噪声建模，并可连接 Google、IonQ 等量子硬件执行任务。
howto.when: 当你需要设计量子算法、模拟噪声或运行量子实验时触发。特别适合针对 Google 量子硬件或进行底层电路设计。

say.text: 帮我写一个贝尔态的量子电路并模拟1000次。
say.note: Claude 会生成并运行电路，输出测量结果直方图。

say.text: 用 Cirq 对参数 theta 从0到2π扫描20个点。
say.note: Claude 会创建参数化电路并执行扫描，返回每个点的结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write, simulate, and run quantum circuits in Python, supporting parameter sweeps, noise modeling, and execution on Google, IonQ, and other quantum hardware.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design quantum algorithms, simulate noise, or run quantum experiments. Best for Google hardware targeting or low-level circuit design.

say_en.text: Write a Bell state circuit and simulate it 1000 times.
Sweep parameter theta from 0 to 2π with 20 points using Cirq.
